# MacFarlane Property Group

> Hands-on property management in Cape Town, Mbombela and Johannesburg. Competitive fees tailored to your property, clear communication and organised rental administration. The service brings together tenant sourcing and assessment, lease and move-in coordination, maintenance coordination, documented inspections and financial reporting.

Contact: dean@macfarlanepropertygroup.co.za · +27711720480
